products.name: SharePoint Online & OneDrive → Google Drive / Shared Drives Migration — Commercial
products.short_description: Migrate SharePoint Online and OneDrive to Google Drive / Shared Drives with deliberate content + permission mapping and per-item validation — files land with the right access, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move files and shares to Drive without losing permissions

SharePoint sites and OneDrive content don't map one-to-one to Google Drive — permissions, sharing, and structure are where these migrations go wrong. This solution migrates SharePoint Online and OneDrive to Google Drive and Shared Drives with a deliberate content/permission mapping, tooling pattern, and per-item validation, so files land in the right shared drives with the right access, executed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the SPO/OneDrive → Drive/Shared Drives mapping model (sites→shared drives, permissions/sharing translation, structure) and the deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (source SPO/OneDrive access, Google tenant/licensing, a migration tool, mapping decisions, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to define the content + permission mapping, run a named pilot, validate files/permissions/sharing, then migrate by wave and validate.
  • 5 supporting scripts — source content/permission discovery, per-item migration + permission validation, a migration coverage/exception report, safe remediation, and a wave target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (files migrated, permissions correct, sharing works) plus Best Practices for shared-drive structure.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

SharePoint and OneDrive content on Google Drive / Shared Drives with permissions and sharing intact — mapped deliberately, validated per item — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWDRIVE-Discovery.ps1 — inventory source SharePoint Online & OneDrive content, structure, permissions, and sharing for a Drive migration
    • GWDRIVE-Remediation.ps1 — safely stage fixes for identity-map and permission-mapping gaps in a Drive migration
    • GWDRIVE-Report.ps1 — coverage and exception report for a Drive migration wave
    • GWDRIVE-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build a Drive migration wave's target group in Microsoft Entra
    • GWDRIVE-Validation.ps1 — per-item migration and permission validation for a Drive migration wave

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
